ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Represents an AI conversation thread scoped to a single user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this session.

lastMessage.description: Preview of the most recent message in the chat.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single prompt or AI response in a chat session.

sessionId.description: The ID of the parent ChatSession.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

content.description: The text content of the message in English or Urdu.

createdAt.description: Message timestamp; clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SavedCreation.title: SavedCreation
SavedCreation.description: Saved AI prompts, knowledge queries, or generated image metadata.

userId.description: The UID of the user who generated or saved this item.

prompt.description: Prompt text entered by the user.

category.description: Domain category: education, technology, science, business, general.

/chat_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection of chat sessions owned by authenticated users.

/chat_messages/{messageId}.description: Collection of chat messages associated with a session.

/saved_creations/{creationId}.description: Collection of user-saved AI Q&A insights and image prompts.
